runtime_limitation: TT logits are read back through generator.generate(next_input=..., host_sampling=True, buffered=False). This mode requires greedy compatibility parameters (temperature=0, top_k=1). Prefill computes the model logits and its greedy token is discarded in favor of the raw-logit argmax; the callback then forces the branch token. Subsequent host_sampling model replays skip sampling and the callback forces every next history token. Recorded histories and raw logits are therefore not stochastic samples. The T=1, top_k=20, top_p=0.95 distributions are reconstructed host proxies from those same logits, not sampler settings used during capture. This captures forced-history logits and host-side distribution summaries, not the canonical device sampler candidate mapping, probability quantization, PRNG state, or sampled draw.
